title: Microsoft Learning Zone: Minecraft Education connected lessons with Build Challenges and class reports
summary: The briefing's roadmap details, product licensing and controls match the Microsoft sources checked. It distinguishes existing product behaviour from the planned integration and leaves integration-specific defaults and licensing open.

claims.claim: Whether Build Challenge matching falls under the documented lesson-generation device limits is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Learning Zone" "Minecraft" license data reporting rollout limits. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone, including Device requirements; no Build Challenge matching rule appeared in the page or relevant search excerpts.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No additional licence requirement specific to connected lessons is yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Learning Zone" "Minecraft" connected lessons default licensing reports; "Learning Zone" "Minecraft" license data reporting rollout limits. Read both cited deployment/licensing pages and Minecraft service-description excerpts; no integration-specific entitlement was stated.

claims.claim: Whether every student assigned a connected lesson needs a Minecraft Education licence, rather than trial access, is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Learning Zone" "Minecraft" license data reporting rollout limits. Read Get and deploy Minecraft Education trial and assignment rules and Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone; neither explains entitlement at connected-lesson assignment.

claims.claim: Global, License or User admin can assign Minecraft Education licences.
claims.quote: You must be a Global, License, or User admin to assign licenses.

claims.claim: The Learning Zone admin page uses an administrator account.
claims.quote: Go to the Learning Zone admin page at https://aka.ms/LearningZoneAdmin and sign in with an administrator account.

claims.claim: At the directly linked Learning Zone admin page, Access settings provides the organisation-wide Learning Zone access switch.
claims.quote: Go to the Learning Zone admin page at https://aka.ms/LearningZoneAdmin and sign in with an administrator account. ... Under Access settings, turn off access to Learning Zone.

claims.claim: No PowerShell or Graph equivalent of the Learning Zone access switch is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "Learning Zone" "Access settings" API Graph PowerShell; "Learning Zone" access settings PowerShell Graph API disable Minecraft integration. Read Deploy Microsoft Learning Zone; results provided its UI switch but no corresponding operation.

claims.claim: Minecraft Education access can be configured at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > user > product license > Minecraft Education.
claims.quote: select Users ... select the users you want to add or remove for Minecraft Education access ... after selecting the product license, ensure to toggle Minecraft Education on

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId <user> -AddLicenses $addLicenses -RemoveLicenses @() assigns licences with the supplied service-plan configuration.
claims.quote: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId '38955658-c844-4f59-9430-6519430ac89b' -AddLicenses $addLicenses -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: The AddLicenses configuration uses SkuId and DisabledPlans to assign a licence with selected service plans disabled.

claims.claim: The mixed licensing model reflects included Learning Zone access and separately assigned Minecraft Education entitlement.
claims.quote: Add the relevant Minecraft Education, A1 for device or A3/A5 license if it is not assigned already

claims.claim: Connected-lessons rollout mechanics beyond the roadmap target are not yet published.
